items.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020
items.q: I kept seeing these three names: Jerry Hey, Chuck Findley, and Gary Grant.

ctx.x: So you see, okay here’s Frank Wess with Basie and then you see Frank Wess over here. And here’s Snooky Young here, and then he shows up — and I used to just love watching the musical chairs. And I’m wondering if you were like that, and did you latch on to some of those lead trumpet players?

Most definitely. And more in the pop world, because I would look at all these records and I kept seeing these three names: Jerry Hey, Chuck Findley, and Gary Grant. I mean on every record that I liked, you know, whether it was an Earth, Wind and Fire record or whatever, I would just keep seeing these names. I go man who are these? They’re on everything. And everything they do sounds great too you know. And so when one of them wasn’t there, you know as a kid I’d look at those things and go, “Wow, Chuck Findley’s…
section. You’d go, “Wow, isn’t he with Count Basie? How could he be doing these two gigs at once?”
